tasks.title: Backend: resume_data table + GET/POST /students/:id/resume-data endpoint
tasks.description: Create a Postgres table resume_data (student_id PK, objective TEXT, projects JSONB, languages JSONB, hobbies TEXT[], extra_curr JSONB, links JSONB, updated_at). Add GET and PUT endpoints at /students/:id/resume-data (requireOwnerOrRole). Also add backend route GET /students/:id/resume-full that merges full-profile + resume-data + internships in one call. Add api client methods getResumeData, upsertResumeData, getResumeFull in frontend/src/lib/api.ts.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Backend build passes. GET /students/:id/resume-data returns saved data. GET /students/:id/resume-full merges all student data.
tasks.commit_msg: feat(resume): backend resume_data table + resume-full merged endpoint

tasks.title: Frontend: ResumeBuilderPage component with editable sections
tasks.description: Create frontend/src/features/resume/ResumeBuilderPage.tsx. Sections: (1) Objective/Summary editor (textarea with ATS tips). (2) Projects: add/edit/delete with title, description, tech_stack[], github_url, demo_url. (3) Internships: pulled from /internships API — show, editable. (4) Languages known: add/delete. (5) Hobbies/Interests. (6) Extra-curricular: title, role, year. (7) Links: LinkedIn, GitHub, Portfolio, LeetCode. (8) ATS Score panel: live scoring (0-100) based on completeness — objective filled (+10), skills > 3 (+15), certifications > 0 (+15), projects > 0 (+15), internships > 0 (+15), academics filled (+10), coding profiles > 0 (+10), achievements (+10) — with green/yellow/red indicator. Layout: left panel = form editor sections with save button, right panel = live resume PREVIEW using CSS (not PDF yet). Remove soon:true from sidebar.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Page loads at /resume-builder. ATS score updates live. All 8 sections editable and save to backend. Preview renders correctly.
tasks.commit_msg: feat(resume): ResumeBuilderPage with ATS score + live preview

tasks.title: Frontend: Professional Resume Templates + PDF Download
tasks.description: Add 3 ATS-friendly resume template renderers in frontend/src/features/resume/templates/. Template 1: Classic (single-column, clean, Times-style). Template 2: Modern (two-column sidebar with skills/certs left, experience right). Template 3: Minimal (all single column, very clean, maximizes ATS). Each template is a React component receiving the full resume data as props. PDF download using jspdf: use html2canvas approach — render the preview div to canvas then save. Add template switcher UI (3 cards to pick). Add a Download PDF button with loading state. The PDF should be A4, properly formatted, with no colored backgrounds (ATS-safe). Name the file <name>_Resume_<date>.pdf.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All 3 templates render. PDF download works and produces A4 PDF. PDF filename is correct. Build passes.
tasks.commit_msg: feat(resume): 3 ATS templates + jspdf PDF download

The card should show the current ATS score percentage with a progress ring.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Navigating to /resume-builder works. Student dashboard home shows resume card with ATS score. Build passes.

tasks.title: Backend: fix attendance crash bugs (not-posted, no-class request, session delete scoping)
tasks.description: GET /attendance/not-posted selects holiday_calendar.holiday_name (column is title) so it 500s on every call; posted-slot matching ignores department so same semester/section/subject in two departments mark each other posted. POST /attendance/no-class-request selects faculty.faculty_name (column is name) so it 500s. DELETE /attendance/sessions/:id HOD department check reads sess.department which is never selected.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tests cover not-posted holiday/department matching and no-class request. Backend tests + build pass.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(attendance): not-posted tracker and no-class requests crashed on every call

tasks.title: Backend: academic calendar lock — no posting outside the semester without admin approval
tasks.description: POST /attendance/sessions: when academic_calendar has entries and session_date falls outside every semester range, faculty/HOD posting is blocked unless an approved late-posting request exists for that allotment+date. New table attendance_late_post_requests; endpoints: POST /attendance/late-post-requests (faculty/hod), GET (admin all, hod dept, faculty own), PATCH :id/approve|reject (admin). Admin posting is never blocked. No calendar configured = no lock (nothing breaks).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Posting after the semester end returns 423 with code SEMESTER_LOCKED; posting is allowed after approval; admin bypasses. Tests pass.
tasks.commit_msg: feat(attendance): lock posting outside the academic calendar until admin approval

tasks.title: Backend: admin day-status + remove-class endpoints
tasks.description: GET /attendance/admin/day-status?date&department&semester&section — every timetable slot for the date with status posted / not_posted / no_class, faculty, session_id, present/total. POST /attendance/admin/cancel-class — admin removes a class (one slot, or every slot of a section/department) for a date: stored as approved no-class entries; optionally deletes an already-posted session. DELETE of a posted session and PUT edit already exist for admin.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Endpoints admin/HOD-scoped, tested, build passes.
tasks.commit_msg: feat(attendance): admin day-status and remove-class endpoints
